# seerr_plex_library_settings (Data Source)

Fetch current Plex library enable/disable settings via `/api/v1/settings/plex/library`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "seerr_plex_library_settings" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `sync_on_read` (Boolean) Whether to pass `sync=true` when reading libraries from Plex.

### Read-Only

- `enabled_libraries` (Set of String) Set of Plex library IDs enabled in Seerr.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `libraries` (Attributes List) List of available Plex libraries discovered on the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--libraries))

<a id="nestedatt--libraries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `libraries`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
